name: Lithium diisopropylamide
typicalUses: Quantitative, irreversible formation of kinetic enolates at −78 °C in THF
chemoselectivity: Deprotonates α-C–H of ketones, esters and nitriles
Bulky and poorly nucleophilic, so it rarely adds to C=O
pitfalls: With an unsymmetrical ketone it gives the less substituted (kinetic) enolate, not the thermodynamic one
